capabilities: Browse passages from current and recent notes by date, people, themes, or projects
Scan selected notes with a language model to find recurring ideas
Keep an idea as a Markdown note with links to its source passages
Add source links back from notes into kept ideas
Ask questions of selected notes and save findings with their original passages
disambiguation: Not a journaling or daily-reflection tool; it resurfaces passages from notes you already have and links ideas back to their sources.
extras: Pre-alpha; the workflow may change. Free to install and use, but optional hosted models require a provider account or API key and may incur provider charges. Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.15.0 or later. Detailed data-and-privacy section explains what is sent to each model provider.
motivation: The author is exploring how to help people come back to their notes, and expects the workflow to change as they learn what users find useful.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to come back to what you have written and see which ideas keep recurring across notes over time.

relations.evidence: Start Ollama and enter a downloaded model ID from ollama list.
Start the LM Studio server and enter a model ID.
Choose an OpenRouter API key and enter the full model ID.
Choose a Claude Console API key and enter the model ID.
The optional Codex companion requires an installed, signed-in Codex CLI.

requires.name: Ollama or LM Studio for local models
OpenRouter, Claude, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint key

summary: Note-review tool that gathers related passages from your notes and uses language models to surface recurring ideas as linked notes.
